svg.text: ROCm 7.14 · Clean rerun after a prefill-threshold change
What / how to read: Checks whether smaller prefill scheduling steps reduce long stalls. Interpret TTFT, prefill throughput and long-stall counts together; the change reduced
some micro-stalls but did not eliminate total stall time.
PP unavailable: completion-credited counter bursts are diagnostic only, not sustained prefill throughput.
